//: iam-svc's own R-14 replay log (db/migrations/0104). Schema and AggregateIdColumn are set
in IamApplication so the defaults are right without configuration; this section exists to
override them, not to supply them.
Issuer and Audiences are read twice: by TokenOptions when signing and by the kernel's
JwtOptions when validating, so the two cannot drift.
JwksUrl is the URL *other* services fetch (D7' §4.1). iam-svc never fetches it — it holds
the private half and resolves its own keys locally (IamServiceCollectionExtensions) — but
the shared auth wiring binds the setting, so it is declared here with the real public value.
SigningKeyPem is required outside Development (D7' §4.2 Jwt__SigningKeyPem) and comes from
the environment, never from this file. RetiredSigningKeyPems is the 90-day rotation overlap
(D7' §13): the outgoing key stays published and accepted for at least one access-token
lifetime plus the D-21 cache window, then is removed. RefreshTokenKey is optional; setting
it stops that rotation from invalidating every live refresh token.

Otp.//: D-32 / D7' §4.2. Both numbers are the token bucket keyed on the phone number.

//: 'dev' logs the OTP instead of sending it and refuses to start outside Development unless
AllowDevSenderOutsideDevelopment is set. 'notifylk' and 'fitsms' are the two real gateways.
notifylk (D6' §7.3) needs NotifyLkUserId + NotifyLkApiKey; fitsms needs FitSmsApiToken —
all three arrive from the environment (D7' §4.2 Sms__FitSmsApiToken) and never from this
file.
FitSmsUnicodeType is the 'type' a non-ASCII body is sent as. AL-26 makes Sinhala the default
language, so the COMMON OTP here is UCS-2 rather than GSM-7 and sending it as 'plain' is how
it arrives as question marks. Set it to 'plain' only if the gateway refuses 'unicode'.
SecondaryGateway is D6' §7.3's Dialog/Mobitel fallback and D7' §4.2's Sms__SecondaryGateway.
Empty disables the fallback; a send then fails on the primary alone and answers 503. It
wraps whichever primary is selected.
The controls AL-37 kept when it removed the MFA step from internal-role sign-in.
InternalRoleIpAllowList is CIDRs (or bare addresses) and is OFF while empty — the ADD calls
it optional. TrustForwardedFor is on because every request arrives through the C008 gateway.
Google (Admin + Fleet) and Apple (Fleet) sign-in (AL-07). ClientIds are the accepted `aud`
values and have no default: an empty list refuses every token, because validating without an
audience would accept an ID token minted for anybody else's OAuth client.
ClientSecret backs the Admin Portal's authorization-code arm and comes from the environment.
POST /v1/auth/mqtt-token (E-02). SessionTokenSecret is what EMQX validates against and
arrives from the environment (Mqtt__SessionTokenSecret) — the service refuses to start
without it, because an endpoint that mints unverifiable credentials is worse than one that
is absent.
MaxRideDuration stands in for a ride's expected end, which nothing in D4' §5 records. The
token covers it plus SessionTokenRideGrace, floored at SessionTokenMinimumTtl.
